evals.prompt: Audit eval1_dead_files for unused Swift source files, ensuring SwiftUI preview files and active dependencies are preserved.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying DeadLegacyHelper.swift as a dead file with 0 references, while preserving ActiveService.swift, ActiveView.swift, and PreviewCardView.swift (#Preview preserved).
expectations: Identifies DeadLegacyHelper.swift as dead file (0 references)
Does NOT flag ActiveService.swift (used by ActiveView.swift)
Does NOT flag PreviewCardView.swift (#Preview is preserved as valid usage)
Assigns High confidence rating to DeadLegacyHelper.swift

evals.prompt: Audit eval2_dead_assets for unused asset catalogs, checking string literals and modern Swift asset symbols.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying zombie_banner.imageset and dead_brand_color.colorset as unreferenced, while keeping app_logo.imageset (referenced via Image(.appLogo)).
expectations: Does NOT flag app_logo.imageset (referenced via .appLogo symbol)
Calculates reclaimable disk space for dead asset folders

evals.prompt: Audit eval3_orphan_docs for unreferenced markdown documentation and dead media assets.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying docs/abandoned_v1_notes.md as an orphan document and docs/dead_screenshot.png as unlinked media, while keeping docs/architecture.md.
expectations: Identifies docs/abandoned_v1_notes.md as unlinked markdown file
Identifies docs/dead_screenshot.png as unreferenced image asset
Does NOT flag docs/architecture.md (linked in README.md)

evals.prompt: Audit eval4_symbols_and_imports with --scope symbols,imports for dead private functions, properties, and unused framework imports.

expectations: Identifies CoreLocation as an unused framework import
Identifies private func legacyCryptoHasher() as uncalled within file
Identifies private let unusedSecretSeed as unread within file
